summary: An agency describes the hearing available to a facility if talks fail to resolve a compliance dispute.
realLife: Federal officials assured Fountain that hospitals would have a chance to contest the issues if voluntary compliance proved impossible.
inGame: needs: an agency compliance case with a notice, corrective agreement and hearing date.

turns.what: The hospital signs a corrective agreement before the hearing opens.
turns.pulledBy: Both sides agree on the admissions changes and who will verify them.
turns.writesBack: The agency cancels the hearing and sets a follow-up visit.

turns.what: The hospital settles the admissions question and contests the room assignments.
turns.pulledBy: The parties agree on only one finding.
turns.writesBack: The hearing notice lists the remaining dispute.
